title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this part, unless the context otherwise requires:

"Authority" or "stadium authority" means the stadium authority established pursuant to section 109-1.

"District" means the stadium development district established by this part.
bodyHtml:
§206E-222  Definitions.  As used in this part, unless the context otherwise requires:

     "Authority" or "stadium authority" means the stadium authority established pursuant to section 109-1.

     "District" means the stadium development district established by this part. [L 2019, c 268, pt of §1; am L 2021, c 146, §7]
